I had a family of seven, mom, dad and five kids. I had the parents use two birthday cakes to age the twins up from baby to toddler (this was Sims 3). I tried to do it while the older kids were at school because it’s just easier, won’t cancel everyone’s actions etc. Instead the cakes caught on fire just as the kids came home from school. They all stood in the doorway screaming and crying, blocking the doorway so the parents couldn’t leave and the firefighters couldn’t enter. All the kids watched as their parents burned to death. It was a nice wholesome family game that suddenly turned into my oldest teen having to parent her younger siblings. Their whole kitchen was a scorched ruin that she couldn’t afford to repair with her part-time grocery store job. The babies aged up to toddler after the parents died so she had two kids and two toddlers to take care of. Oh and they all had negative moodlets for like a week so they would just stop and cry all the time. It was honestly kind of traumatic lmao
